message: "users"."email" is set to NOT NULL, which scans the whole "users" table while blocking reads and writes.
why: SET NOT NULL holds an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock and checks every row, unless a validated CHECK constraint already proves the column has no NULLs.
safeAlternative: Add CHECK ("email" IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID, validate it in its own transaction, then SET NOT NULL (PostgreSQL skips the scan because the CHECK proves it) and drop the CHECK. With TypeORM, migrationsTransactionMode "all" (the default) runs every pending migration in one transaction, so deploy the VALIDATE migration in a later release, or use "each".
